original_sentence: A 2020 report by Citi indicated that "Black students could have increased their lifetime incomes $90-$113 billion" if equity issues related to higher education had been adequately addressed over the past two decades.
translation: 花旗 2020 年的一份报告指出，如果过去二十年里与高等教育有关的公平问题得到充分解决，“黑人学生本可以将其终身收入增加 900 亿至 1130 亿美元”。

key_vocabulary.usage_note: over the past two decades 在本句中对应"过去二十年里"。
equity issues 在本句中对应"公平问题"。
adequately addressed 在本句中对应"得到充分解决"。
lifetime incomes 在本句中对应"终身收入"。
higher education 在本句中对应"高等教育"。
